params.body: Since the evening of 11 September the daily mirror to the public copy has failed on one attachment: the action beside the workbench's step 3, a DENY record, is an empty file on the machine (a reset landed mid-write; control gets an atomic write in its own PR). The gateway answers 500 for it and the mirror stopped there, so the public copy still shows 11 September and neither the major-upgrade hand nor the workbench have ever reached it. The mirror now names an unreadable attachment in coverage.json (unreadable_attachments) and in its output, and carries on. Test added.
params.title: control-publish: one unreadable attachment does not stop the mirror, and is named
